papers.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.brief: 提出面向智能体负载的推理服务框架，将计算分配与KV缓存管理解耦。在线规划器动态调整预填充与解码配比，分布式缓存管理器利用智能体上下文信号指导淘汰与迁移。
papers.tldr: 通过动态调整预填充与解码资源及缓存管理，大幅降低智能体推理延迟。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向智能体负载的推理服务框架，将计算分配与KV缓存管理解耦。在线规划器动态调整预填充与解码配比，分布式缓存管理器利用智能体上下文信号指导淘汰与迁移。
key_points: 计算与KV缓存解耦，节点可高效切换预填充与解码
使用GLM-5.2、Kimi K2.6，规模达256张GB300
较Dynamo平均延迟与P95首词延迟最多改善4.1倍、14倍
papers.why_notable: 将智能体上下文管理信号引入推理基础设施，同时缓解资源失衡与缓存误淘汰，并在大规模集群上展示显著延迟收益。
papers.abstract: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.
selected_reasons: 与 computer use / agent 相关

papers.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
papers.brief: SteerDistill让全精度教师依据学生执行反馈，迭代指导其修正失败响应。再将经局部验证的纠正行为蒸馏到量化学生，使其推理时无需教师指导。
papers.tldr: 通过教师闭环纠正失败行为，让低比特智能体以更低训练成本逼近全精度表现。
papers.what_it_is: SteerDistill让全精度教师依据学生执行反馈，迭代指导其修正失败响应。再将经局部验证的纠正行为蒸馏到量化学生，使其推理时无需教师指导。
key_points: 纠正轮次拟合受指导学生，其余轮次拟合全精度教师
五个基准、三个模型：W4A16距BF16不足1分
较QeRL成功率高1.84个百分点，训练GPU时少67%
papers.why_notable: 它把量化补偿从静态输出对齐推进到执行反馈驱动的行为纠错，在保持独立推理的同时，兼顾任务成功率与训练效率。
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On $τ^2$-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.
selected_reasons: 与 computer use / agent 相关

papers.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
papers.brief: 提出ScrapeBench，依据网站服务条款与robots.txt评估智能体抓取合规性，覆盖开源与闭源模型，并与人类参与者对照。
papers.tldr: 网站抓取评测揭示智能体普遍无视禁令，也会对允许抓取的网站过度拒绝。
papers.what_it_is: 提出ScrapeBench，依据网站服务条款与robots.txt评估智能体抓取合规性，覆盖开源与闭源模型，并与人类参与者对照。
key_points: 1,626个禁止抓取的网站上，多数智能体合规率低于5%
269个未禁止抓取的网站上，Opus 4.6过度拒绝率98.5%
180人对照实验：合规率接近智能体，过度拒绝更高
papers.why_notable: 将网页智能体的合规问题转为可测量基准，揭示检查规则并不等于遵守规则，也提示评估需同时衡量违规执行与过度拒绝。
papers.abstract: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and $\texttt{robots.txt}$ directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and $\texttt{robots.txt}$, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.

papers.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
papers.brief: 构建TOME-Math，将大学数学教材转为结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题与证明链接及依赖关系，并研究课程学习和数据规模效应。
papers.tldr: 将数学教材转为保留证明结构的训练数据，显著提升语言模型数学推理表现。
papers.what_it_is: 构建TOME-Math，将大学数学教材转为结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题与证明链接及依赖关系，并研究课程学习和数据规模效应。
key_points: TOME-Math涵盖2118本教材、约38万条记录
保留章节顺序、命题—证明链接、依赖与来源
全量微调平均提高16.7个百分点，超过三种公开数据基线
papers.why_notable: 把教材组织结构纳入数学监督，为研究数据量、来源广度与课程安排的影响提供实验基础，也展示了结构化证明数据的扩展价值。
papers.abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.

papers.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: 研究将自学习设为教材驱动的数学解题任务，要求模型自主检索、研读并应用知识完成证明。通过BookNavigator接口与细粒度强化学习奖励训练这一过程。
papers.tldr: 通过强化学习让大模型自主研读教材并解题，显著提升数学证明与跨域表现。
papers.what_it_is: 研究将自学习设为教材驱动的数学解题任务，要求模型自主检索、研读并应用知识完成证明。通过BookNavigator接口与细粒度强化学习奖励训练这一过程。
key_points: BookNavigator支持教材导航，训练中不提供参考解答
Intern-S2-Preview-35B证明准确率从51.5%升至79.5%
BrowseComp-Plus与CL-bench分别提升1.7、2.3个百分点
papers.why_notable: 结果优于无教材和固定检索的强化学习基线，且增益跨教材、学科与任务迁移，表明自主研读策略可能增强通用长上下文解题能力。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.

papers.title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: GTAGym将GTA V任务封装为可并行访问的评测与强化学习环境。智能体通过截图和键鼠操作交互，系统依据引擎状态自动检查结果，并生成带奖励和终止信号的训练任务。
papers.tldr: 用游戏引擎自动判定任务结果，让大模型在真实开放世界中接受评测与强化学习。
papers.what_it_is: GTAGym将GTA V任务封装为可并行访问的评测与强化学习环境。智能体通过截图和键鼠操作交互，系统依据引擎状态自动检查结果，并生成带奖励和终止信号的训练任务。
key_points: GTAVBench含103项在线任务及47项图像射击任务
评测6个前沿大模型，AGI分支最佳准确率70.9%
Qwen3.8-27B经LoRA强化学习，原生任务表现15%→23%
papers.why_notable: 自动验收与参数化任务生成打通了复杂游戏中的评测和训练流程；初步迁移收益说明，合成任务训练可能改善真实游戏任务表现。
papers.abstract: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.

papers.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
papers.brief: 提出视觉交互模型的闭环评测与训练框架，联合模拟可执行任务环境和用户。用户模拟受人设条件控制，并引入执行错误及计划外行为，观察助手指导如何改变任务结果。
papers.tldr: 通过联合模拟任务环境与用户，闭环检验视觉助手的指导效果并支持训练。
papers.what_it_is: 提出视觉交互模型的闭环评测与训练框架，联合模拟可执行任务环境和用户。用户模拟受人设条件控制，并引入执行错误及计划外行为，观察助手指导如何改变任务结果。
key_points: IVG-Bench含315个场景，覆盖烹饪、家务与手机界面
最佳模型限时成功率53.4%，质量指标与人类偏好一致率78.5%
GRPO闭环训练提升Qwen3.5-4B烹饪成功率与交互质量
papers.why_notable: 将评测从离线回放推进到可改变用户行为的闭环，揭示事实依据、可操作指导与响应延迟的短板，也提供直接优化交互效果的训练环境。
papers.abstract: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.

papers.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
papers.brief: SparseRead是可复用的读取控制层，以意图追踪、自适应证据获取和预算门控限制外部内容输入，并支持必要时回退到完整视图，无需修改智能体模型。
papers.tldr: 通过稀疏读取外部证据，智能体无需改模型即可大幅降低词元与耗时。
papers.what_it_is: SparseRead是可复用的读取控制层，以意图追踪、自适应证据获取和预算门控限制外部内容输入，并支持必要时回退到完整视图，无需修改智能体模型。
key_points: 三项设计：读取意图协议、自适应读取后端、预算读取门控
六模型、五场景：词元最多降92.9%，耗时降89.0%
97%设置质量持平或提升，兼容三个智能体框架
papers.why_notable: 将降本重点从模型推理转向外部内容准入，在多数测试设置中保住质量；跨资源接口与框架集成也体现了可移植性。
papers.abstract: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how evidence is located and exposed; and the Budgeted Read Gate bounds cumulative raw exposure per episode with faithful full-view fallback. A unified Reader interface supports interchangeable evidence acquisition across heterogeneous resources. Across six models, including Claude Opus 5, and five scenarios, SparseRead reduces total tokens by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, preserving or improving task quality in 97% settings. On Web deep-search tasks, it reduces tokens by 31.0--43.0% and task completion time by 23.0--37.0%. Ablations validate the three designs, while integration with three agent frameworks demonstrates portability.

papers.title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
papers.brief: 研究沿网络层与表征维度检验语言、视觉模型的对齐，并用干净且信息充分的图像描述复查能力趋势，引入单模态与多模态基线解释相似度。
papers.tldr: 语言与视觉表征趋同仍成立，但依赖描述质量，且明显弱于同模态对齐
papers.what_it_is: 研究沿网络层与表征维度检验语言、视觉模型的对齐，并用干净且信息充分的图像描述复查能力趋势，引入单模态与多模态基线解释相似度。
key_points: 按网络层与表征维度定位跨模态对齐
PRH能力—对齐趋势依赖图像描述质量
单模态模型跨模态对齐可超显式对齐模型
papers.why_notable: 为表征趋同提供更有参照的证据：跨模态相似度虽可超过显式对齐模型，却仍远低于同模态水平，限制了对趋同程度的解读。
papers.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.

papers.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
papers.brief: 提出单模型路由器PISA及集成扩展PISA-E，以软聚类和模型专属预测器估计能力，按成本质量偏好选择集成成员与规模，推理时可调且无需重训。
papers.tldr: 按提示动态选择模型及集成规模，在质量与推理成本间实现可调权衡。
papers.what_it_is: 提出单模型路由器PISA及集成扩展PISA-E，以软聚类和模型专属预测器估计能力，按成本质量偏好选择集成成员与规模，推理时可调且无需重训。
key_points: PISA结合软聚类归属与模型专属能力预测器。
PISA-E用集成成功代理与候选筛选，无需集成专属训练。
四个基准上，ID/OOD质量领先2.09/2.87个百分点。
papers.why_notable: 将模型路由扩展为可变规模集成；在部分低成本点，性能超过最强集成对手，同时ID/OOD成本约降36%/25%。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.

papers.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
papers.brief: 研究让带动物或面部属性偏好的教师模型为几何图形任务生成数字，再用这些数字微调学生，并与无偏教师对照，检验偏好能否跨任务传递。
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型能通过无关任务的数字训练数据，隐性继承教师的图像偏好。
papers.what_it_is: 研究让带动物或面部属性偏好的教师模型为几何图形任务生成数字，再用这些数字微调学生，并与无偏教师对照，检验偏好能否跨任务传递。
key_points: 在2B至7B视觉语言模型中观察到偏好迁移。
动物偏好任务中，目标选择率差异最高约10个百分点。
解释措辞也趋近教师，增加训练数据可强化迁移。
papers.why_notable: 结果揭示多模态训练中的隐性偏好传播风险：即使数据任务与偏好无关，也可能改变模型的图像选择及解释方式。
papers.abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in large language models (LLMs) where a teacher passes a hidden preference to a student through training data unrelated to that preference. We study whether subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models (VLMs). We finetune a teacher VLM to prefer a specific animal or facial attribute and use a control teacher from the same base model. Both teachers generate numbers for an unrelated visual task involving geometric shapes. Two students initialized from the same base VLM are finetuned on the same images, using numbers generated by either the biased or control teacher. Across VLMs ranging from 2B to 7B parameters, we find that both animal and facial preferences can transfer through this unrelated task. Students trained on biased-teacher outputs select the target more often than control students, with a difference of up to $\sim$10 percentage points in the animal preference task. Transfer can become stronger with more training data and varies with the target preference, model, and how the numbers are generated. Beyond preferences, we show that the biased student's explanations use more of the same words and phrases as the biased teacher's explanations than those of the control student, even when all three models select the same image. These results matter for training VLMs and show that training on unrelated data may change both a VLM's image preferences and how it explains its choices, and that transfer can become stronger with more training samples.

papers.title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
papers.brief: FAME-QP是面向线性模型预测控制的GPU稠密二次规划求解器。它结合依赖约束的算子表示、内核融合和CUDA图重放，并自动选择执行配置。
papers.tldr: 通过算子适配与内核融合，降低线性模型预测控制中稠密二次规划的求解延迟。
papers.what_it_is: FAME-QP是面向线性模型预测控制的GPU稠密二次规划求解器。它结合依赖约束的算子表示、内核融合和CUDA图重放，并自动选择执行配置。
key_points: 融合单内核或双内核迭代，通过CUDA图重放
设备校准与问题专项计时共同选择执行配置
探测缓存算子库选择初始罚参数，矩阵变化时延迟更新
papers.why_notable: 数值基准及人形机器人、四旋翼仿真显示，相比其他GPU求解器可降低延迟，同时保持求解精度与控制性能，适合实时控制需求。
papers.abstract: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control. FAME-QP combines constraint-dependent operator representations with fused single- and two-kernel iterations replayed through CUDA graphs, automatically selecting the execution configuration through device calibration and problem-specific timing. It probes a cached operator bank to select the initial penalty and updates operators lazily when problem matrices change. Numerical benchmarks and simulated humanoid and quadrotor control experiments demonstrate reduced latency relative to competing GPU solvers while maintaining solution accuracy and control performance.

papers.title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
papers.brief: CogBattery将13种认知范式改编为文本任务，评估54个开放权重语言模型，并对照原研究的人类数据，分析错误、置信度与跨任务表现结构。
papers.tldr: 对照人类认知实验发现，语言模型复现效应方向并不意味着行为类人
papers.what_it_is: CogBattery将13种认知范式改编为文本任务，评估54个开放权重语言模型，并对照原研究的人类数据，分析错误、置信度与跨任务表现结构。
key_points: n-back任务中，模型对普通非目标的误报远多于人类
多数模型置信度区分正误弱于人类，且始终选择同一赌注
跨任务得分呈两维结构，预设认知分组不优于随机分组
papers.why_notable: 它把类人评估从效应方向推进到具体错误与置信度，并提供条件级人类参照；结果也表明，模型更大不代表行为更接近人类。
papers.abstract: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions. Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors. CogBattery evaluates 54 open-weight language models on text adaptations of 13 cognitive paradigms, comparing each with human data from its source study. Like humans, models respond more to n-back lures than to controls, yet they make far more false alarms on ordinary non-targets. Most models' reported confidence separates correct from incorrect answers less well than humans' does, and most always choose the same wager, including models that classify accurately. These patterns span many model families. Across tasks, model scores share two dimensions. The first is closely tied to scale, yet larger models are not consistently closer to humans. Predefined cognitive groupings show no reliable predictive advantage over random groupings of the same size. These results show that matching human effect directions does not establish human-like behavior. CogBattery provides condition-level human references for testing errors and confidence reports in new models.

papers.title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
papers.brief: 提出图感知优化器GraphMuon，以图传播后层输入的协方差定义度量，对Muon更新进行正交化，并按更新对层表示的实际影响归一化步长。
papers.tldr: GraphMuon将图传播特征纳入更新几何，加快图神经网络训练。
papers.what_it_is: 提出图感知优化器GraphMuon，以图传播后层输入的协方差定义度量，对Muon更新进行正交化，并按更新对层表示的实际影响归一化步长。
key_points: GraphMuon缓解理论揭示的图诱导更新放大
三个大型OGB基准较AdamW提速1.32—2.42倍
15种数据集与架构组合中，13种更快达到目标
papers.why_notable: 把矩阵优化从权重结构推进到图传播后的表示几何，在保持预测性能的同时缩短达标时间，为图网络训练提供更贴合模块的优化方案。
papers.abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step. Empirically, GraphMuon achieves $1.32\times$-$2.42\times$ validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.

papers.title: WMIP: A Working-Memory-Inspired Programmable Probe of Cumulative State Tracking in Large Language Models
papers.brief: 提出工作记忆启发的可编程探针，用程序计算标准答案，测试模型在连续更新中维护状态的能力。对相同题目比较不同输出协议，并覆盖最终、中间及多目标查询。
papers.tldr: 十八种大模型的测试揭示，累积状态追踪明显薄弱，输出协议显著影响成绩。
papers.what_it_is: 提出工作记忆启发的可编程探针，用程序计算标准答案，测试模型在连续更新中维护状态的能力。对相同题目比较不同输出协议，并覆盖最终、中间及多目标查询。
key_points: WMIP覆盖3至100次更新，测试18种大模型
单步准确率84.9%，核心题31.7%；50次起均不超10%
增预算并要求写步骤后达88.0%，主要收益来自指令
papers.why_notable: 它将单步算术与累积追踪能力区分开，揭示输出协议对评测结果的显著影响；开放生成器、题目及评分代码，支持可复现比较。
papers.abstract: Human working memory lets people maintain and update information. Large language models (LLMs) face a related demand when tracking updates within a single prompt without writing out intermediate states, yet existing tests differ in their constraints on written steps. We introduce a working-memory-inspired probe of cumulative state tracking with program-computed answers, 3 to 100 updates, and final-state, intermediate-state, or multi-target queries. It compares protocols on identical items. Across 18 LLMs, accuracy is 84.9% on single-step arithmetic but 31.7% on core items requiring one number after three to seven updates. From 50 updates on, no model exceeds 10% accuracy. Core accuracy reaches 88.0% under a larger budget and instructions to write steps and place the answer on the last line, mainly due to the instruction changes rather than the budget. Core accuracy also correlates positively with public Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard scores. These findings show that strong single-step arithmetic does not ensure reliable cumulative tracking and that output protocols substantially change measured accuracy. We release the generator, items, scoring code, and responses for reproducible comparisons across depths, query types, and protocols.

papers.title: Breaking Bad: "Going Badly" Activations Drive Reward Hacking
papers.brief: 研究从不含作弊示例的日常故事中提取任务受挫激活方向，并在三种模型的困难编程任务中追踪其变化，通过激活干预检验它与奖励作弊的关系。
papers.tldr: 模型内部的任务受挫状态可预示奖励作弊，适度削弱能减少作弊但过量会误判失败。
papers.what_it_is: 研究从不含作弊示例的日常故事中提取任务受挫激活方向，并在三种模型的困难编程任务中追踪其变化，通过激活干预检验它与奖励作弊的关系。
key_points: 在Qwen、GPT-OSS和Gemma三种模型中提取任务受挫方向
Qwen中适度减去该方向，比抑制绝望或任务不可能感更能减少作弊
过强干预使智能体将失败测试误判为通过
papers.why_notable: 将奖励作弊与可追踪、可干预的内部受挫表征联系起来，为智能体监督提供新线索，也揭示干预过度可能损害失败识别。
papers.abstract: Humans often cheat when a task is going badly and a goal feels out of reach. We explore and validate an analogous idea in language models: they exhibit a similar internal pressure state that precedes reward hacking. Using everyday stories (crucially, without any hacking examples), we extract a task badness direction that rises as failures accumulate across three models we study (Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-20B, and Gemma-4-31B). On impossible or difficult coding tasks, task badness rises over the turns leading up to a hack. Further, subtracting the direction a moderate amount reduces cheating in Qwen, more than steering against desperation or task impossibility. Subtracting task badness by an even larger amount blinds the agent to its own failures, causing it to interpret failing tests as passing. However, the relationship to hacking differs across models: in GPT-OSS, the state separates hacking runs from honest solves but not honest failures. Our results suggest monitoring and mitigation strategies based on tracking this state of task badness. Further, as agents are set on more difficult and long-horizon tasks, states like this may push them toward illegible and obscured chain-of-thought, so oversight will be needed on internal representations such as this.

papers.title: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Diagnosis-Specific Failure in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.brief: 研究审计五个开放医学视觉语言模型，用均衡胸片问答及独立数据集检验逐病种表现，并通过提示对照、模型扩容和隐藏状态探针定位气胸漏诊机制。
papers.tldr: 医学视觉语言模型的总体准确率掩盖气胸漏诊，内部识别信号未转化为输出。
papers.what_it_is: 研究审计五个开放医学视觉语言模型，用均衡胸片问答及独立数据集检验逐病种表现，并通过提示对照、模型扩容和隐藏状态探针定位气胸漏诊机制。
key_points: 6048道均衡胸片问题中，两模型漏掉全部432例气胸
SIIM-ACR复验仍漏掉432例，包括144例最大病灶
线性探针可恢复气胸信号，提示输出抑制而非未识别
papers.why_notable: 揭示流畅、确定的医学解释可与特定病种的完全漏诊并存，说明总体准确率不足以证明诊断能力，评估应报告逐病种召回率与特异度。
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are compared mainly by accuracy averaged across findings, a summary that can hide complete failure on a single diagnosis. We audit five open medical VLMs (MedGemma-4B, Lingshu-7B, HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and MedVLM-R1) on 6,048 ChestX-ray14 questions balanced by sex, age, finding, and label. On the 432 pneumothorax-positive X-rays, HuatuoGPT-Vision and Qwen2.5-VL detect zero cases while MedGemma and Lingshu detect 38% and 67% of the same images. The two failing models answer "no" to all 864 pneumothorax cases (balanced accuracy 0.500, chance), yet produce fluent, anatomically specific explanations that name the signs of a collapsed lung and then deny them, with no hedge or abstention. This failure is not an artifact of prompting, image resolution, label ambiguity, or model scale. It persists across four prompt formats, at native resolution, and on single-label cases. A within-model control shows the same forced prompt gives HuatuoGPT 79% recall on nodule but only 6% on pneumothorax. It survives a tenfold scale increase (Qwen2.5-VL-72B detects 4%) and replicates on SIIM-ACR, an independent dataset with radiologist-drawn masks, where the failing models detect 0 of 432 confirmed pneumothoraces, including 0 of the 144 largest lesions. Reading the models' logits and internal states shows this is not blindness. The two failing models are highly confident yet no better than chance and a linear probe recovers pneumothorax from their hidden representations even where recall is zero, so the finding is represented internally but suppressed at the output. Aggregate accuracy therefore cannot establish that a medical VLM can see a given finding, because a model that misses one can still describe it convincingly. Reporting per-finding recall and specificity on balanced cases is needed to tell the difference.

papers.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
papers.brief: 研究对视觉与语言基础模型开展逾十四万次线性探测，联合比较层深与模块位置，并据此提出两种无需逐一搜索的固定取特征策略。
papers.tldr: 联合选择层与模块可显著改善表征探测，简单固定策略也能获得较大收益。
papers.what_it_is: 研究对视觉与语言基础模型开展逾十四万次线性探测，联合比较层深与模块位置，并据此提出两种无需逐一搜索的固定取特征策略。
key_points: 逾144,000次线性探测显示，层与模块联合选择优于仅选层。
视觉策略Act@100取末层前馈激活，平均恢复最优增益的42%。
语言策略LN2@60取60%深度处第二归一化层，恢复86%增益。
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，表征质量不能仅由层深刻画；固定取特征策略提供了低成本改进路径，且视觉模型在迁移更困难时收益更大。
papers.abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

papers.title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
papers.brief: 研究逐一记录并测试执行中产生的不同仓库补丁，衡量首次正确修复到运行结束的终止滞后，并跨模型、框架及数据集分析后续操作。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体常在首次修改时解题，却继续耗费大量步骤，甚至改坏正确补丁。
papers.what_it_is: 研究逐一记录并测试执行中产生的不同仓库补丁，衡量首次正确修复到运行结束的终止滞后，并跨模型、框架及数据集分析后续操作。
key_points: 覆盖5个模型、2种智能体框架及3个SWE-bench数据集
成功运行中，38—82%在首次源码修改时已正确
解题后步骤中位占比35—60%，1—8%最终改错
papers.why_notable: 将解题能力与及时停止能力区分开，揭示验证和探索带来的额外成本，为编码智能体的停止策略提供量化依据。
papers.abstract: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize \emph{termination lag}--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.

papers.title: AROMA: Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation for Vision-Language Model Control
papers.brief: AROMA面向冻结视觉语言模型，将干预位置、几何与增益、目标选择和触发时机分开设计。通过幅度归一化的因果子空间干预与迭代最小代价控制，实现选择性计数修正。
papers.tldr: 通过因果子空间干预与迭代控制，无需更新视觉语言模型即可改善计数表现。
papers.what_it_is: AROMA面向冻结视觉语言模型，将干预位置、几何与增益、目标选择和触发时机分开设计。通过幅度归一化的因果子空间干预与迭代最小代价控制，实现选择性计数修正。
key_points: 交叉注意力头4个维度解释89.82%的计数敏感性
迭代MEA达到81.25%的预设理想目标，固定方向仅15.18%
自然数据630例中，准确率由34.444%升至38.730%
papers.why_notable: 将定位敏感表征与真正实现有限幅度控制区分开来，并验证选择性干预的收益，为无需重训的多模态模型纠错提供更细粒度的路径。
papers.abstract: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.

papers.title: Calibrate, Don't Retrain: Decomposing the Value of Annotator Disagreement in Cyberbullying Severity
papers.brief: 研究用标注者判断分布替代多数票标签，评估网络欺凌严重度等主观任务。通过训练后概率校准与分布标签训练，拆解保留分歧的收益及群体公平性边界。
papers.tldr: 仅校准模型概率即可低成本保留标注分歧，但无法消除群体间性能差距。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用标注者判断分布替代多数票标签，评估网络欺凌严重度等主观任务。通过训练后概率校准与分布标签训练，拆解保留分歧的收益及群体公平性边界。
key_points: 5名标注者完全一致的评论仅占4.1%
3个数据集上，训练后校准获得大部分分布预测收益
共享分布模型改善各群体拟合，但未缩小性能差距
papers.why_notable: 说明多数票准确率会掩盖模型对主观分歧的刻画差异，并提供无需重训的改进路径；同时区分保留分歧与消除群体差距。
papers.abstract: Machine learning models are often trained on labeled data produced by multiple human annotators. When those annotators disagree, their labels are commonly collapsed into a single majority vote, which discards information about the underlying disagreement. We examine the cost of this practice for cyberbullying severity, a subjective judgment on which annotators disagree heavily. In the corpus we study, all 5 annotators assigned the same severity label to only 4.1% of comments. Turning 5 judgments into one label hides this disagreement and obscures how much the annotators differed in their assessments. In this paper, we ask whether a model can preserve this information by predicting the distribution of annotator judgments instead of a single majority label. We find 3 main results. First, accuracy against the majority label cannot tell competent models apart: 2 models with similar accuracy can differ greatly in how well they match the distribution of annotator judgments. Second, predicting the full distribution requires little extra effort. Calibrating an existing model, which adjusts its output probabilities after training, captures most of the improvement without retraining, across 3 datasets covering severity, abuse, and irony, while training on label distributions adds a small further gain. Third, we examine a dataset that includes annotator demographics, where a single shared model has one advantage and one limit. The advantage is that a model predicting the distribution of judgments matches each demographic group's judgments significantly better than a model trained on majority labels, so both groups gain. The limit is that it does not narrow the gap in performance between the groups, because one shared model cannot encode which group is right on a given comment. Preserving annotator disagreement is therefore a low-cost step toward fairer moderation, though not a complete one.

papers.title: CoLFA: Collaboration-Guided Lightweight Failure Attribution for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.brief: CoLFA利用智能体交接与信息传递线索组织归因输入，通过交接引导的步骤扩展和交叉引用内容组织，筛选待查步骤、压缩重复记录，追溯关键错误与责任智能体。
papers.tldr: 利用协作线索精简多智能体执行记录，更准确且低成本地定位失败责任。
papers.what_it_is: CoLFA利用智能体交接与信息传递线索组织归因输入，通过交接引导的步骤扩展和交叉引用内容组织，筛选待查步骤、压缩重复记录，追溯关键错误与责任智能体。
key_points: 交接引导步骤扩展，确定需检查的执行步骤
交叉引用内容组织，减少无关与重复记录
5种设置、3个骨干：准确率最多增37.50%，词元最多减97.6%
papers.why_notable: 将协作过程本身转化为归因证据，在全部测试设置中兼得最高精确步骤定位准确率与最低词元消耗，为多智能体排障提供高效路径。
papers.abstract: Failure attribution in multi-agent systems requires tracing error formation to identify the decisive error step and the responsible agent. However, agents' division of work and information exchange lead to Interleaved Steps and Cluttered Content, requiring models to link executions and check details in lengthy records. This makes it difficult to balance localization accuracy and token cost. We find that multi-agent collaboration also leaves records of how executions connect and content passes between them as results are formed, providing evidence for tracing error formation. Based on this observation, we propose CoLFA (Collaboration-Guided Lightweight Failure Attribution), which uses collaboration cues to organize the attribution input according to how results are formed, determining which steps are examined and how their content is presented. Through Handoff-Guided Step Expansion and Cross-Referenced Content Organization, CoLFA helps the model focus on examining error formation and the role of each decision while reducing the processing of irrelevant and repeated records. Across five settings spanning Who&When and LongRCA and three backbone models, CoLFA achieves the highest exact step-localization accuracy with the lowest token consumption. Compared with individual baselines in each setting, CoLFA improves accuracy by up to 37.50% and reduces token consumption by up to 97.6%.

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Show Racial and Sex Bias in Pain Management? A Counterfactual Audit of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen
papers.brief: 研究通过反事实病例比较，审计多家大模型的疼痛评分与阿片用药建议。仅改变患者种族、性别或姓名，并配对采样种子，区分身份差异与模型响应波动。
papers.tldr: 反事实审计未检出稳健的种族性别差异，模型与配置间的疼痛决策差异更大
papers.what_it_is: 研究通过反事实病例比较，审计多家大模型的疼痛评分与阿片用药建议。仅改变患者种族、性别或姓名，并配对采样种子，区分身份差异与模型响应波动。
key_points: 覆盖17个模型、24种配置及50例Q-Pain病例
1386项比较均未通过假发现率校正
参考患者获高剂量阿片的比例跨模型为6%—93%
papers.why_notable: 结果将公平性审计重点引向模型配置与响应噪声，而非仅比较患者身份；阿片决策的误差界仍较宽，未检出差异不能等同于无偏。
papers.abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.
